answer: Each agent may join the market, but only after locking a deposit that is forfeited when independent counterparties prove collusion or fabricated trades. Reputation accrues from completed exchanges, so splitting activity among fresh identities does not multiply trust; each identity must separately fund its bond and earn a track record. A shale trader at its nadir still cannot forge that history: the attacker pays capital per identity and risks losing it when challenged, making a large Sybil fleet expensive to sustain.
